title: Watch Your Language: Investigating Content Moderation with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative error analysis of false positives to identify instances where the model erroneously flags benign content due to the presence of profanity or slurs used in neutral or positive contexts (e.g., colloquial speech).

Qualitative error analysis identifying false positives triggered by the model's inability to contextualize reclaimed derogatory racial slurs (such as those used in African American Vernacular English) and demographic stereotypes.
Qualitative error analysis of false negatives to identify missed instances of toxic generalizations or implicit hostility directed at specific countries (e.g., Nigeria).

Qualitative error analysis of false positives identifying benign comments incorrectly flagged as hate speech simply because they contain religious identity terms (e.g., Jewish) used defensively or to rebuff stereotypes.
